instructions: Sign in to the AWS console with an administrator user of the account you want Raviga to deploy into.
Open the link; it pre-fills a CloudFormation stack that creates one IAM role named RavigaDeployRole.
Tick the acknowledgement that the template creates IAM resources, then choose Create stack.
Wait for the stack to show CREATE_COMPLETE (about a minute), then come back and tap Verify.
To revoke access at any time, delete the stack in CloudFormation.
